**Overview:** The EV Adaptation model (Danish: Elbil-tælleren) counts the battery-electric cars (BEVs) in the Danish passenger-car fleet and forecasts when the fleet reaches one million BEVs, later milestones, and the fleet composition to 2040. A small stock-flow model is refitted automatically every month when Statistics Denmark publishes new registration and stock figures (tables BIL51 and BIL52). The tool also shows the car tax revenue the state does not collect because BEVs replace petrol cars, and the CO2 this saves, with adjustable assumptions. The page is in Danish and English; switch language in the app header.

This is a **beta version**. The forecast and the tax calculation are under development, and the methods note describes the model, its backtest and its limitations.
